description: This file contains a class 'OpenIdMigrations' that manages database schema migrations for OpenID-related data using YesSql in an OrchardCore project. It defines methods for creating, updating, and dropping index tables and migrating data collections.

classes.name: OpenIdMigrations
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for managing database schema migrations related to OpenID entities such as tokens, authorizations, applications, and scopes in an OrchardCore environment.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates initial index tables and indexes for OpenID entities, returning the migration version number 8.

methods.name: UpdateFrom1Async
methods.description: Adds a 'Type' column to the OpenIdTokenIndex table, returning version 2.

methods.name: UpdateFrom2Async
methods.description: Drops certain reduce index tables and recreates them with new definitions, returning version 3.

methods.name: UpdateFrom3Async
methods.description: Adds 'CreationDate' columns to authorization and token indexes, returning version 4.

methods.name: UpdateFrom4Async
methods.description: Creates various indexes on existing tables for optimization, returning version 5.

methods.name: UpdateFrom5Async
methods.description: Creates indexes on index tables for logout URI, redirect URI, and role name, returning version 6.

methods.name: UpdateFrom6Async
methods.description: Recreates token and authorization index tables with collection parameter, then recreates indexes, returning version 7.

methods.name: UpdateFrom7Async
methods.description: Recreates application index tables and indexes, migrates existing applications and scopes to new collections, drops old index tables, and returns version 8.
